trigger: cross-plugin boundary (plugin lib to shared F11 verifier via risk_recheck.json), gate semantics, runner-contract change

doubts.claim_under_doubt: a unit declared medium in the brief can no longer be recorded small
doubts.disproof_attempt: The floor exists only if the orchestrator copies the brief tier into a complexity key when it calls campaign_init; wording said may carry and nothing checks the copy. A missing key reads as undeclared and passes F11.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Make the wording mandatory, or record each unit declared tier in campaign.md so the setup review shows the omission.

doubts.disproof_attempt: A runner launched from the stale plugin cache uses the old contract without --spec; declared_complexity is null and F11 cannot tell undeclared from omitted.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Record that a spec was consulted, or state that the post-merge cache sync is mandatory before any campaign dispatch.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: a spec with no declaration behaves exactly as before
doubts.disproof_attempt: The parser searched the whole spec, so free scope or acceptance-criteria text such as Complexity: large or Complexity: TBD could raise the tier or hard-fail a unit; a malformed header line was skipped when a valid line appeared later.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Parse only the header region and let the first declaring line decide.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the floor is local to campaign units
doubts.disproof_attempt: F5c entries recorded at the declared floor feed the history-prior median used by standalone iterates.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Accept in writing or exclude declared-sourced entries.

summary: Two medium doubts are the same opt-in gap at two hand-offs (brief to key, runner to --spec under a lagging plugin cache); two low doubts on parser scope and history-prior drift.
